title: Guard OpenCode handoff on the terminal assistant response
description: REQ-OPENCODE-TERMINAL-001: The OpenCode adapter may not report a successful implementation handoff from an intermediate completed assistant message. In the live CV task, the session contains a completed initial progress message followed by more assistant messages, and the persisted messageId points to the progress message. Inspect only the latest response belonging to the dispatched prompt; require it to be completed and the session idle before success, while preserving model fallback/error handling.
acceptanceCriteria: Regression test with intermediate completed assistant message and a later final response returns only the final response; incomplete latest response cannot be accepted as success; exact message must match session and prompt parent; existing 429 retry, 403 fallback and timeout tests remain passing; npm run kalite and git diff --check pass; no dependencies and no commit.
